title: Pomp and Circumstance March No. 1
video_use_ideas: Graduation, a milestone or a speaker walk-on.
recording_performer: "The President's Own" United States Marine Band (recorded 1988)
legal_notes: FLAG death year, same family of caution as Holst: Elgar died 1934. This march was published in 1901, before 1930, so the composition is PD-US. Life+70 countries: PD since 2005. Commons composition tag pd-old-auto-expired|1934 claims PD where the term is life+80 or fewer, and PD-US for publication before 1 Jan 1931. Performance tag PD-USGov-Marines redirects to PD-USGov-Military-Marines (U.S. government work, public domain in the United States). ID3 in the file names the 17 Apr 1988 band-hall album. Foreign status of the recording varies. Nimrod was not used: the easy Commons file is a 1947 commercial recording still protected in the US.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
